items.title: Marvell Stock Ran, But Did It Tell You When?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock has returned 248% since September 22, 2025, against about 18% for the S&P 500 over the same window. The products that drove that run were named in public months before the share price moved. None came with a date.

items.title: Broadcom Just Made a Move That Further Solidifies My Decision to Buy on Repeat
items.summary: Broadcom's latest earnings dropped a set of forward projections so aggressive that ignoring them starts to feel like a mistake. Here is why one investor keeps adding shares on every single paycheck.

items.title: What Changed In AMD's Story?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) has stopped leading with the problem that opened its call a year ago. That problem was keeping one of its accelerators out of China. The latest call was fiscal Q2 2026. This time, management did not lead with the subject at all. So what was AMD leading with back then.

items.title: This Magnificent Seven Stock Could Turn $10,000 Into $20,000 by 2027
items.summary: One Magnificent Seven stock is quietly building a case that its biggest gains still lie ahead, and the math behind a potential doubling of your investment by 2027 is harder to dismiss than you might expect.

items.title: Two Chip Giants, Two Very Different Dividends. Which One Pays You Better?
items.summary: Texas Instruments and Broadcom both raise their dividends every year, but the gap between their yields and growth trajectories forces a choice that retirement investors rarely think through carefully enough.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Falls. It Has a Google AI Chip Conundrum.
items.summary: A familiar problem is haunting  Nvidia  The chip maker’s stock has paused in its latest effort to break out to new highs and part of the problem is Google.  Nvidia shares were down 0.4% at $228.06 in early trading Wednesday.  The biggest threat is  Alphabet’s  Google and its Tensor Processing Units, designed in collaboration with  Broadcom  Although Nvidia and Google’s rivalry is generally an amicable one, investors keep a close eye on which chips the biggest players use.

items.title: Want to Play Anthropic Before Its IPO? There’s an ETF for That.
items.summary: It’s an actively managed fund with big holdings in major chip companies las well as hyperscalers. In other words, the usual AI beneficiary suspects.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Set For 40% Surge: 3 Catalysts That Could Drive the Next Big Move
items.summary: Nvidia just posted triple-digit revenue growth and Jensen Huang says the company can only fulfill 70% of demand, yet the stock still trades well below where the math points. Three converging forces suggest the gap between current price and fair value may close faster than most investors expect.
